overall.verdict: The desktop-light variant of xln wallet demonstrates strong design execution with excellent implementation of the visceral value bar principle and clean, premium aesthetic. The interface successfully communicates complex financial concepts through intuitive visualizations while maintaining readability and trust cues. However, there are opportunities to improve data hierarchy and typography consistency across screens.
priority_fixes: Increase font sizes for critical financial data (amounts, fees, frame numbers)
Integrate redundant text into tooltips and fields for better context
Make verification and proof elements more prominent for trust
Standardize typography hierarchy across all screens
Improve data legibility in low-emphasis states
